solid-notion 0.1.1 Changelog

- Added clear instructions for obtaining a Notion API token by creating and configuring a Notion integration.
- Expanded the authentication setup section to guide users through integration setup steps.
- No other functional or command changes; documentation quality improved for onboarding.

Initial release of solid-notion, a CLI tool for managing Notion pages as Markdown.

- Provides commands to read, edit, write, and synchronize Notion pages and blocks.
- Supports authentication with the Notion API via multiple secure methods.
- Allows local reversible changesets and workspace editing flows.
- Includes detailed command references for browsing, searching, reading, and patching pages.
- Offers structured patch application with full rollback and submit workflows.
- Outputs in machine-readable JSON and Markdown formats for integration.
